verdict.rationale: Grafana's OSS nature, provisioning/config-as-code docs, and CLI for managing multiple environments (including local development) support spinning up a dev instance, and Loki docs explicitly describe running locally for quick experimentation. However, no direct docs/quick-start for launching a local Grafana server itself (e.g., Docker/binary) are cited, only CLI and provisioning references. missing for 10: explicit local Grafana install/quick-start docs, hands-on developer confirmation of local dev workflow.
